mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mt_shop_peak_window_profile ( shop_id, day_type, profile_status, lookback_days, sample_day_count, sample_order_count, peak_windows_json, unavailable_reason, generated_at, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{shopId}, #{dayType}, #{profileStatus}, #{lookbackDays}, #{sampleDayCount}, #{sampleOrderCount}, #{peakWindowsJson}, #{unavailableReason}, #{generatedAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE profile_status = VALUES(profile_status), lookback_days = VALUES(lookback_days), sample_day_count = VALUES(sample_day_count), sample_order_count = VALUES(sample_order_count), peak_windows_json = VALUES(peak_windows_json), unavailable_reason = VALUES(unavailable_reason), generated_at = VALUES(generated_at), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
